input.body: We are writing to request a review of a $19.00 deduction on order DD-51131, dated 2026-11-06, which was issued with the reason "wrong item" for Chicken Momo (Steamed). The order ticket for DD-51131 lists Chicken Momo (Steamed), which shows the order was prepared as it was placed [DD-51131:ticket_lists_item]. Our records also show the order was ready at 19:31 and picked up at 19:34, so the handoff to the courier took place 3 minutes after it was ready [DD-51131:pickup_handoff]. We cannot show what was in the bag after handoff, so we are stating only what the ticket and timestamps record. Based on this, we ask that you review the deduction and reverse it. Thank you for your time and consideration.
